nom: Clinique Moisture Surge Broad Spectrum SPF 28 Sheer Hydrator Moisturizer

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily or acne-prone skin generally report the formula absorbs without greasiness or breakouts, though a few note a shiny or oily finish, especially in the T-zone.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, including very dry or desert-climate skin, consistently report all-day hydration without residue and describe it as one of the few moisturizers that works for them.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin report it balances dry and oily areas without greasiness, though some notice increased T-zone oil.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin are split: several say it is the only SPF moisturizer that doesn't irritate them, while others report burning, allergic rash, or swollen eyes.
segments.mature: Reviewers with mature or aging skin report it feels nourishing, reduces the look of fine lines, and works well layered over serums.
segments.normal: The one reviewer identifying as combination-to-normal skin reports good feel but increased T-zone oil over the day.

concerns.aging: Reviewers focused on aging skin report plumper, more nourished skin and reduced appearance of fine lines when layered over serums; no dissent noted.
concerns.dehydration: Reviewers with dehydration or dry skin overwhelmingly report lasting hydration without residue or greasiness; one reviewer reports the opposite, that the product made her skin extremely dry and caused peeling.
concerns.redness: One reviewer reports reduced redness in the cheeks after use; another reports the product burned her skin and eyes and caused an allergic rash, which increased redness.
concerns.barrier: A reviewer with rosacea and extremely sensitive dry skin reports easy, irritation-free daily use; several other reviewers describe burning, itching, or allergic reactions suggesting barrier sensitivity to the formula.
concerns.spots: One reviewer reports fewer breakouts and mostly faded acne scarring; several other reviewers across different skin types report new breakouts after starting the product.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers who mention blemishes report no new breakouts and one describes reduced acne and scarring; several others, including two women in their 70s, report the product caused breakouts.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily skin mostly report an oil-free, non-greasy feel, but multiple reviewers with oily or combination skin note the product increases T-zone oil or leaves an oily/shiny finish.

extraits.texte: I've been using Clinique products for most of my adult life. The yellow moisturizer has always been too heavy for me but I like the light moisture surge 100H. Since I play a lot of golf, I was looking for a product with spf. I tried this one with the SPF 28, even though it is pricey, and it made my skin breakout - I'm 74!!

Ive been using clinique products for a long time and when they came up with this SPF moisturizer, i was super excited. The first night i tried it my whole face was burning, specially my eyes. It was alsmost like i touched chilies and then rubbed by eyes. I washed my eyes with cold water three times and went to sleep cause I literally couldnt bear it. Next morning when i woke up, my eyes were not burning anymore but they were swollen and it took the whole day for it to go down. Because of that, im even scared to try the eye cream from them. Ive always used their products with any hesitations, this one now made me cautious and im very skeptical of buying new products from them, specially skin care.

I have extremely sensitive skin and this is the best moisturizer/sunscreen I've found! I started using the moisture surge line a year ago and fell in love with the products. I had been putting off trying this one because spf sometimes breaks me out. That, however, has not been a problem with this product! So glad I can wear spf now and not be afraid of what will happen to my skin after. Hoping this product and the moisture surge line is around for years to come!

I am a fan! I have mature skin and find this to be the best daytime moisturizer to use from Clinique. A little goes a long way and I apply it over my Wrinkle Repair Serum. My skin feels nourished and hydrated which helps reduce the look of fine lines. It's also helpful in making sure I use a sunscreen on my face. I'll definitely purchase again!

extraits.titre: Absorbs quickly, not greasy, not white.
extraits.texte: The first facial sunscreen moisturizer I've ever been able to sustain using. I have extremely sensitive dry skin and rosacea. I have no patience with using products that require work or time. I find it very convenient and rewarding to use this product every morning. I wish it weren't so expensive but I'll use it as long as I can.
Feels very moisturizing and lightweight. I have oily, acne prone skin but this works great with the other skincare products that tend to dry out my skin and it doesn't irritate or break out my skin.

I've been dealing with acne and acne scars since I've been very stressed lately. None of the creams I bought really helped until I used this! This leaves my skin so hydrated and I'm barely getting any acne and the scaring is almost gone! And the fact that this has SPF is just a cherry on top.
